Name: Gedaliah, Son of Pashur
Summary: Gedaliah, son of Pashur, was one of the princes who demanded Jeremiah's death, charging that his prophecies weakened the hands of the soldiers and the people. He is a different man from Gedaliah the governor.
KeyStory: Gedaliah son of Pashur told Zedekiah that Jeremiah ought to be put to death, and Jeremiah was let down into the dungeon of Malchiah.
RelatedPeople: Zedekiah, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Pashur, Son of Malchiah
LifeLesson: Calling truth treason is the oldest way to silence a prophet.
